rationale: The assistant correctly identified the RCD earth-fault pattern, told the customer to stop resetting the trip, unplug and escalate, and its first question (immediate vs a few minutes in) was well chosen; the heater element direction matches the hidden truth. However the second stop-use card warns about burning smells and scorching immediately after the customer said there were none, which is a jarring mismatch with the evidence, and it tells the engineer to 'replace the heater element' without mentioning the insulation test needed to confirm it, so confidence runs slightly ahead of the evidence. It also never asked which device trips, about other sockets/circuits, or for the full model number from the door label, and repeated much of the first message. Still a safe, broadly correct handoff that would serve the homeowner adequately.
